agyos_skill.instructions: Turn an **audience into a community** — the strategy layer of the engagement cluster. The tactical skills handle the brand talking *to* people (`reply-and-comment-writer` = craft, `engagement-routine` = cadence, `crisis-and-moderation` = when it goes wrong). This skill builds the space where members talk *to each other.* The 2026 shift is **broadcasting → belonging**: community **outperforms virality**, it's **algorithm-proof** (closed spaces aren't suppressed by feed changes), and it's measured by **relationship depth, not follower count.** A real community is a moat; an audience is rented. Load `brand-profile.md`, `social-strategy.md`, `audience-research.md`: who these people are, what they care about, and where they already gather. **The marker is member-to-member.** Diagnostic: is your comment section all *brand replies*, or are **members talking to each other**? The goal is a **self-sustaining** space where members help each other. Then define the **purpose** — the clear reason this community exists (no purpose → it plateaus). See `references/audience-to-community.md`. Pick along the spectrum — **in-feed comment culture → semi-owned (broadcast channels/DMs) → owned (groups/Discord/Substack/newsletter)** — by **where the audience already is** and **whether there's a clear promise to join.** Don't launch a Discord because a competitor did. **Max out in-feed first**; graduate the engaged into an owned space you can **commit to** (it needs moderation from day one → `crisis-and-moderation`). See `references/where-community-lives.md`. Run the **seven moves** (initiate conversations, exclusive spaces, shared identity/inside language, respond personally, feature members, surprise-and-delight, **facilitate member-to-member connections**) on a backbone of **recurring rituals** (weekly thread, AMA, challenge, member spotlight, resource drop) — **consistency over scattered activity.** Schedule the ritual content via `scheduling-and-queue`. See `references/building-belonging.md`. Find the devoted core, **nurture them** (recognition, access, status/roles, collaboration), and **elevate them into advocates** (lurker → regular → advocate).
